mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is a negative predictor of S&P 500 forward returns: higher rates compress equity discount rates and signal tighter monetary policy, producing negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS exceeds the 75th percentile of its historical range (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises above 257.0, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 257.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 255.0, it signals a high-inflation, high-rate regime that compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 255.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, it signals a late-cycle expansion with overheating labor market conditions, triggering equity market corrections and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE < 4.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1350.0, it signals a weakening housing market that may indicate broader economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1350.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment (PAYEMS) rises above 152000.0, it signals a strong labor market supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS > 152000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) rises above 110.0, it signals strengthening supply chain activity and economic growth, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO > 110.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) rise above 530000.0, it signals strong consumer demand supporting corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 530000.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.
